Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
North-West Frontier Province (Amendment Of
Certain Laws) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance further to amend
certain laws
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 8th August, 2005]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier Province
(Amendment of Certain Laws) Ordinance, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 8th August, 2005]
2. Amendment of certain laws.--The laws specified in column 3 of
the Schedule appended to this Ordinance shall be amended to the extent and in
the manner specified against each in column
4 of the said Schedule.

1. In section 3, in subsection (1) for the word "two thousand",

2.
N.-W.P.P. Act No.III of 1975.
The North-West
Frontier Province speaker and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances
and privileges) Act, 1975.
1. In section 13, for the
words" four hundred and fifty" the words "seven hundred"
shall be substituted.
2. In sections 25, for the
words "four hundred and fifty", the words "seven hundred"
shall be substituted.
3. After section 25, the
following new section 25A shall be inserted namely:
"25A.? Accommodation
allowance.---Where official accommodation is not provided to the Speaker
or the Deputy Speaker during his tour, he shall be paid accommodation
allowance at the rate of one thousand and eight hundred rupees per day for
the period of residence on duty:
Provided that the Speaker and
the Deputy Speaker shall not be required to produce any written certificate
or voucher while claiming accommodation allowance under this section."
